floater.name: shoe_height
floater.title: AUTO HEIGHT FROM SHOES
floater.string: Select your shoes, then click Set height. An invisible T-pose sample keeps animations out of the calculation. Stand on a level surface; loaded mesh detail affects accuracy.
No worn world attachments found. Wear your shoes and reopen this window.
Avatar height adjustment is unavailable in this region.
Stand still on the ground before setting height. Your standing animation can keep playing.
That attachment is no longer worn. Reopen this window to refresh the list.
The complete attachment geometry is not loaded yet. Wait for your shoes to finish loading and try again.
Could not locate a visible floor near the avatar's support surface. Wait for the floor to load or move onto a level surface and try again.
The calculated height is outside the allowed range. Check that you selected the shoes and are standing on a level surface.
